title: What’s in Your Network – What sorts of Risks are hiding in plain sight?
summary: Learn how vulnerability management strengthens modern cybersecurity. Join Xerox IT Solutions to explore today's threat landscape and security services.
body_markdown:
## AI changes the rules when it comes to detecting Network risk


This session gives clients a grounded look at why vulnerability management has become critical to a modern security program, and how it fits into a broader defense strategy. Rather than a vendor pitch, this is an Xerox® IT Solutions-led overview of the current vulnerability management landscape followed by a walkthrough of Xerox IT Solutions' overall security catalog — giving attendees a clear picture of the services and capabilities available to them.


### What’s in Your Network – What sorts of Risks are hiding in plain sight? October 6, 2026 at 11:00 AM CST


60-Minute Live Session + Q&A


#### What you'll learn:


-


Why vulnerability management has become a critical, non-negotiable part of a modern security program.


-


The current landscape of vulnerability management: what's changed, and what "good" looks like today.


-


How proactive vulnerability management supports frameworks like NIST, CIS, and CMMC.


-


An overview of Xerox IT Solution's full security catalog and where these services fit together.


#### What's in it for me?


Leave with a clear understanding of where vulnerability management fits in your security strategy today, and a full view of the[Xerox® IT Solutions](https://www.xerox.com/en-us/services/it-solutions) services available to help close the gaps.


Register now
